product_one_liner.value: SiMa.ai provides purpose-built edge-AI hardware and software that helps developers build and deploy physical-AI applications on devices such as robots, vehicles and industrial systems.

pricing_page.notes: Edgematic lists Free, Premium and Business plans.

named_customers.notes: The robotics page mixes customer and partner stories without identifying which names are customers; the STIGA announcement specifically describes a partnership, so two non-partner customers cannot be substantiated from these sources.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn reports a company size of 201–500 employees.

eng_blog.notes: Both are technical posts by SiMa.ai engineering leaders, covering ML compilation and Modalix chip design.

public_docs.notes: The public Developer Center links hardware and software documentation and contains product-development articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live listing includes Principal Engineer, AI & ML Design Verification.

model_provider.value: Gemma is explicitly shown in SiMa.ai’s Modalix conversational-AI example; its platform also supports multiple model architectures rather than naming one exclusive provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The public privacy/legal page does not name any of the specified certifications.

raised_18mo.notes: The Series C was announced September 28, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live job board lists openings but none is an SDR, BDR or account executive role.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The company’s small management-team page and available dated profile evidence do not show a C-level or VP join/exit within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable current job listings do not name a CRM or sales/marketing system.
